### God Rested
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/god-rested.html
Passage: Genesis 2:3
Points:
- God rested not out of fatigue, but because His creative design was complete and needed no revision.
- The seventh day lacks mention of morning and evening, signaling an ongoing invitation into relationship with God.
- Sabbath provides a recurring rhythm to step back and reflect on life under God's gracious care.
- The rest instituted in creation points forward to the spiritual rest found in Jesus and the final resurrection.
- Believers are invited to honor this pattern by taking intentional time for communion with the Creator.

### God Rested
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-rested
Passage: Genesis 2:3
Points:
- God ceased from the work of creation, though He continuously sustains all things and actively redeems His people.
- The perpetual nature of the seventh day highlights that divine rest endures to uphold believers today.
- Setting apart one day in seven establishes a healthy pattern to pause ordinary creative labors.
- Christians observe this Sabbath principle on the Lord's Day to commemorate the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
- Sunday rest is best used for corporate worship, mutual fellowship, and practical deeds of love.
